text:
Maya: opened small PR to tighten the dedicated provisioning migration doc and add a compact autoscale SDK + terraform create example. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2512

Alex: quick scan: SLA wording mixes p90/p99 guidance. split soft vs hard SLOs? Also saw a broken link to /dedicated/old-provisioning.

doc-linter: broken-link in docs/dedicated/migrate.md: line 64 -> https://docs.redwood.dev/dedicated/old-provisioning (404).

Sanjay: terraform snippet references reserved_pool_id but no creation sample. suggest one-liner HCL so customers don't assume implicit creation.

Maya: added HCL one-liner and annotated isolation note: "# reserved pools are isolated; check eviction_protection for job-level preemption". snippet:
```hcl
resource "redwood_reserved_pool" "demo" {
  name = "migration-demo"
  gpu_count = 4
}
```

Lucy: updated python SDK example to use configure_autoscale instead of deprecated set_scale_policy. added parenthetical: `(target_utilization is fraction, e.g., 0.75 == 75%)`.

Alex: added migration checklist item: validate eviction_protection via `redwood-cli pools describe rp-demo --show-eviction-status`.

Maya: pushed fixes and requested reviews.

doc-linter: link-check passed after replacement.

deploy-bot: PR merged by Maya (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/b7c4fa1). Release note: "docs(dedicated): clarify SLAs, add autoscale SDK and terraform reserved_pool example, migration checklist"

Maya: thanks everyone, will follow up with console screenshot in a separate PR.
